description.value: COBS Bread is a Canadian franchise bakery — part of the Bakers Delight family — that bakes all products from scratch on-site every day, with no refrigeration or freezing of goods. The Langley location offers a broad range of breads, baguettes, buns, bagels, scones, cruffins, croissants, and savoury items including pizza. At the end of each day, unsold baked goods are donated to local charities.
